results.name: T1. login lands on the Angular dashboard
the dashboard shows no simulated figures until the sample is requested
dashboard learning panel shows real progress from Spring (missions passed, Live integrated, no "not migrated")
a new account starts with an empty watchlist

prices are labelled fictional and simulated
every instrument in the database is marked fictional
results.detail: ATL CTB GOV MDX OLV SFX TEK

results.name: T3. selecting an instrument opens the trading desk for it
without a portfolio the desk offers to create one
creating a portfolio records 100,000 DT of opening capital once
the KPI shows the stored cash
Web Storage holds only the active portfolio id, never a token
T4. preview shows the server review for the chosen order
fee and total shown are the server estimate

results.name: a preview writes nothing

the confirmation states the stored fill
results.detail: This order was already placed; here is its result. Bought 10 ATL at 16.886 DT on average (fees 0.500 DT).

results.name: a double click sends one order reference; the repeat is replayed, not executed again
the cash ledger matches the portfolio and debits notional plus fee
T6. the trade appears in recent trades
the position shows 10 units
the cash KPI equals the stored cash
T7. resending the same order is replayed with the original result
the replay writes nothing
the same reference with different terms is refused

results.detail: You hold 0 CTB; you cannot sell more than you hold. Change the order and preview it again.

results.name: a submitted rejected order is stored as REJECTED and moves no cash

results.name: its cash is reserved, not spent

the order history lists every stored order with its status
the trades tab lists the single fill
the cash tab lists the opening deposit and the buy
